name: Braenet
summary: Corporate ISP (Cisco Regional ISP); acquired by Savtek Internet Services ~2003.

events.details: Braenet founded December 1996 by Braemac (semiconductor distributor); high-end corporate ISP; Cisco Regional ISP status 1 Jul 1999. Birth predates the archive (earliest braenet.com.au capture Jan 2001), but the 2001 'Company History' page states the Dec 1996 founding.

refs.label: Braenet Company History (Wayback 13 Oct 2001) — founded December 1996 by Braemac

events.details: Acquired by Savtek Internet Services: braenet.com.au still showed the Braenet corporate ISP site in Mar 2002 but had become Savtek.net by Mar 2003 (Savtek dialup changes effective 31 Jan 2003).
